speaker: john_heminges
text: The boxes, Will. Saturday, as I said on Monday. I am opening them. I am not opening the coffer at your lodging, and I am not asking you to.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Open yours. I have had a supper and a play since I asked you to wait, and I still do not want a sum that is not this house.

speaker: margery_pell
text: The gowns went with the term. My stair knew it today, which is sooner than Monday, and I am not grateful to be right. I have not brought my figure. John has the book.

speaker: john_heminges
text: The gatherer is right to keep her stair. This is the company. Your share is two-and-thirty shillings.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I have heard it. I will write the share at home, and I will not write a total under it.

speaker: margery_pell
text: Write what he said. Do not write my stair into it. The lawyers are gone, and what they spent is not a man's purse at this table.

speaker: john_heminges
text: The court money is not in this box. George and I are named for it. Naming is not paying. I will not enter a purse that has not come.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then it is not entered. Quiney's pound is not this box either. That debt is a man in Carter Lane, and he still owes it.

speaker: john_heminges
text: One pound of his is none of my tally. I am not collecting Stratford on a Saturday.

speaker: margery_pell
text: Titus filled what the gowns left empty. I am not telling you the play. I am telling you the stair held. You were in it. I do not know as what, and I do not ask.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I was in it. The gown had no new name. That is as much as I am giving a reckoning.

speaker: john_heminges
text: The plot knew the play. The share does not need the part. I have said the figure. I am not saying it again for the pleasure of a round number.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Romeo, from Monday. Five mornings, at nine. The sixth is the opening. We are not playing it before that.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Five mornings. I have heard the number. I am not writing the play into this box, and I am not calling it on today.

speaker: margery_pell
text: A morning is not a stair. Keep the number out of my figure, which I have not brought.

speaker: john_heminges
text: The tally shuts when you have heard me. The mornings are a peg, not a purse.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I have heard you. Shut it. I am not carrying the boxes home.

speaker: margery_pell
text: Then get off my count, both of you. I have a stair to lock, and a Saturday is long enough.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Locked when I say. Will, the hired men's hose are still to be looked to. Not tonight. Tonight is the share and the shut.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Tonight is the share and the shut. I am not richer than the line I will write, and I am not counting past it.

speaker: margery_pell
text: Master Shakespeare, you played, you take what John has said, and you go home. I have seen men turn a good Saturday into a bad week by counting it twice. Do not.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I am going home to write one line and turn two locks. That is the whole of my counting.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Then we agree. Tuesday's joy stays Tuesday's. This box is the week, and the week is shut.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Shut. God keep you, John. Goodwife, your stair is your own.

speaker: margery_pell
text: It always was. Go home while the light holds. I am not walking you to Bishopsgate.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Go. I will see the locks on these before I see my own door.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: And I on mine. No total under the line. The habit is the shut, and the habit is not a new sum.

speaker: margery_pell
text: Habits do not spend. Good night.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Good night. The pot at home is not this table, and I am glad of the difference.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Glad is not a figure. Off you go.
